Quotes.title: What do you believe in ?
list: I believe in people who make gut decisions because they feel truly inspired and driven by strong values.
I believe in people who give generously to others because they believe in the transformative power of sharing with an individual.
I believe in people who inspire others by their way of thinking and acting, and who are consistent with themselves.
I believe in people who take responsibility, leading to either change or acceptance.
I believe in people who feel fully alive because they come into contact with a concept that transcends their individuality.
I believe in people who dare to challenge the status quo, even if it means being seen as crazy by those who fear change.
I believe in people who make love because they have lost themselves passionately in their partner’s gaze.
I believe in people who dare to reach out to others, who respect their true nature and for whom authenticity requires being vulnerable.
I believe in people who have strong self-awareness, which leads them to use emotional and relational intelligence.
I believe in people who dare to develop their uniqueness, rather than conforming to boxes that don’t suit them.
I believe in people who prioritize real human interactions over digital ones, striving to build genuine connections and lasting trust.
I believe in people who have the courage to move beyond their fears and horizons, to offer the world the uniqueness that defines them.
I believe in people who know how to turn hardship into inner energy, a force that lets their beauty, madness, and vitality shine, without locking themselves into roles that don’t truly fit them.
I believe in people who, through sincere words and actions, bring forth the beauty and living strength that reside within every individual.
I believe in people who believe.
I believe in you!

QuotesPro.title: What future of work do you wish for ?
list: I believe in a world of work where people are driven not only by salary, but by passion and deep commitment to a mission they truly believe in.
I believe in a world where expertise across seemingly unrelated fields fosters creative, innovative, and original ideas, helping us adapt to rapid technological change.
I believe in a professional world that recognizes talent and potential beyond past achievements, giving everyone a fair chance to demonstrate their capabilities.
I believe in the constant capacity to learn and to build connections between existing knowledge and future possibilities in a rapidly changing world.
I believe in the power of languages as cultural bridges that foster meaningful personal and professional relationships beyond transactional exchanges.

about.quote-pyramid: A good relationship with oneself (spiritual, athletic, health) allows for good relationships with others (family, friends, acquaintances, lovers) and enables one to give the best of oneself in the service of others!

success.title: My definition of meaning
success.p1: Having enough freedom to meet and work with people I truly want to collaborate and spend time with. Be able to connect and build trust with people who believe what I believe.
success.p2: Success, to me, is about creating something that lives beyond me.
success.p3: Something that moves people, sparks ideas, emotions, and imagination.
success.p4: Success is creating something that becomes part of someone else’s memories, inspiring them to dream and create in return.
